scenarios.name: job processor re-throws error so BullMQ can retry
scenarios.description: Verifies that job processors re-throw errors after marking failed, enabling BullMQ's automatic retry mechanism

scenarios.name: dead-letter log fires when attemptsMade >= max attempts
scenarios.description: Confirms dead-letter logging triggers when retry limit is exhausted

scenarios.name: dead-letter log does NOT fire before max attempts
scenarios.description: Ensures dead-letter logging does not trigger prematurely during retry attempts

scenarios.name: notification job re-throws so BullMQ retries on DB failure
scenarios.description: Verifies notification jobs propagate errors for retry on database failures

notes: Unit tests verify retry logic at the code level. Live Redis/BullMQ integration tests are not implemented due to test environment constraints. The worker implementation (src/workers/) correctly implements error re-throwing for BullMQ retry mechanism. Failed jobs are retained in BullMQ up to 200 jobs as configured. There is no dedicated dead-letter queue - failed jobs remain in their original queues with failed status.
